frases: Treated wood in your raised bed? That's poison in your tomatoes!
Hit like and follow. Flo is about to lose this one!
It's soaked in chemicals! Arsenic! Everybody knows that!
That was the old stuff. Arsenic treated wood was pulled from home use at the end of 2003.
So the new wood is totally clean?
Not totally. Today it's treated with copper.
Oregon State built garden beds with it, and tested the soil for years.
The extra copper stayed within about one inch of the boards.
And the vegetables? No copper buildup.
Never use old boards from before 2004. And plant a few inches in from the wood.
Treated wood in your raised bed. Safe, or poison? Team Norm or Team Flo?
